recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast cinematic composition featuring a muscular male figure in profile, heavily tattooed, set against a background of blurred, aggressive orange and yellow flames. The lighting is dramatic, highlighting muscle definition and skin texture with a warm, fiery glow while keeping the front of the figure in deep shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject silhouette against a bright, chaotic fire background
Textural contrast between smooth skin and intricate black ink tattoos
Horizontal typographic bands framing the central action logo
Warm-to-dark color gradient creating depth and intensity
coreInvariants: Chiaroscuro lighting on the subject's back and arm
Blurred, streaking fire background for a sense of motion
Wide, extended sans-serif typography for secondary information

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale male figure positioned on the left third, facing right, cropped at the waist and shoulder.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central stylized graphic logo positioned in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bright tattoos on the arm, moves up to the profile face, then across to the central logo and down to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows on the left side of the figure provide a resting point for the eye.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for shadows and silhouettes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant orange and yellow for the fire and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Metallic silver/white for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background flames contrasted with zero saturation in the deep shadows.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are stretched horizontally to create a sense of speed and stability
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A dominant, ultra-wide sans-serif for names/titles paired with a smaller, highly tracked version of the same face for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the industrial, wide-set aesthetic of early 2000s action media.
Provides the necessary square-geometric feel with wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a muscular man's back and profile in shadow, featuring intricate black tribal tattoos on the shoulder and arm. The background should be a blurred, high-energy explosion of orange and yellow flames. Lighting should be rim-light style from the right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-wide, bold sans-serif text at the top and bottom. In the center right, place a 3D metallic red beveled graphic with sharp, aggressive edges and horizontal speed lines.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with deep blacks?
Are the tattoos clearly visible against the skin highlights?

adjustableVariables: Metallic sheen on the central logo
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fire background does not overwhelm the subject's silhouette.
Check that the wide tracking in the text remains legible.
Verify the 3D effect on the central graphic feels integrated into the lighting.
Confirm the tattoos look like ink on skin, not a flat overlay.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast character silhouette with a motion-blurred elemental background, framed by ultra-wide, industrial-style typography.
